name: Shadow Form

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Your body flattens and loses its color, becoming a two-dimensional being of living shadow. You gain immunity to precision damage, resistance 10 to void and to non-magical physical damage, and weakness 5 to any damage with the light trait. You can Squeeze at full speed through any space with at least one dimension a foot wide. Your shadow spells deal additional damage equal to the spell's rank (of the same damage type as the spell).

---
Heightened (9th) The resistance increases to 15, and the weakness increases to 10.

Spell Effect: Shadow Form
